notes: Charts pulled from the rePebble store API “Most Loved” collections — real hearts, not paid placement.
Animated faces look incredible and eat battery. Check battery-impact hints in the store when available.
Filter by hardware (aplite / basalt / chalk / diorite / emery / gabbro) so you do not sideload a build that will not fit.
Music Boss and other active devs ship PT2/Round 2 fixes often — heart your favorites so updates surface in the app.

watchapps.title: Misfit
watchapps.author: Misfit
watchapps.description: The OG activity companion — sleep and step tracking that still earns hearts a decade later. Pairs with the phone app for goals and history without turning your wrist into a fitness billboard.

watchapps.title: Music Boss
watchapps.author: Reboot's Ramblings
watchapps.description: The media remote Pebble people refuse to uninstall. Album art, layouts for every era of watch, and active PT2/Round 2 updates with touch-friendly controls.

watchapps.title: Pixel Miner
watchapps.author: WearGa
watchapps.description: Retro mining on your wrist — tap, upgrade, repeat. A pocket-game vibe that proves e-paper can do cozy without melting the battery.

watchapps.title: Morpheuz
watchapps.author: James Fowler
watchapps.description: Smart alarm that watches your sleep cycles and wakes you in a lighter phase. Community classic for anyone who hates jarring buzzers.

watchapps.title: Battery+
watchapps.author: Ycleptic Studios
watchapps.description: Honest battery stats and predictions on-watch. Install early on a fresh Pebble so you know whether that animated face is worth it.

watchapps.title: Timer+
watchapps.author: Ycleptic Studios
watchapps.description: Kitchen-timer energy with presets and labels — the kind of utility app that stays pinned for years.

watchapps.title: Compass
watchapps.author: Pebble
watchapps.description: Simple heading on your wrist when GPS feels like overkill. Hikers and festival-goers still swear by it.

watchapps.title: Cards for Pebble
watchapps.author: Keanu Lee
watchapps.description: Flashcard drills on the bus — lightweight learning without pulling out your phone.

watchapps.title: Tiny Bird
watchapps.author: StuartHa
watchapps.description: Flappy nostalgia, Pebble-sized. Short sessions, big grin, surprisingly addictive on four buttons.

watchapps.title: Dialer for Pebble
watchapps.author: matejdro
watchapps.description: Initiate calls from your watch when your phone is buried in a bag. Niche now, beloved when it worked everywhere.

watchapps.title: Timer
watchapps.author: Pebble
watchapps.description: Official Pebble timer — dead simple and always worth having if your firmware bundle skipped it.

watchapps.title: Stopwatch
watchapps.author: Pebble
watchapps.description: Official stopwatch with clean lap timing. Another “grab it from the store” baseline utility.

watchfaces.title: YWeather
watchfaces.author: David Rodríguez Rincón
watchfaces.description: Shake-for-weather royalty — current conditions plus today’s forecast on one glanceable face. Still topping Most Loved for a reason.

watchfaces.title: TimeStyle
watchfaces.author: Freakified
watchfaces.description: The configurable face everyone recommends to newcomers. Mix digital and analog elements until it matches your vibe.

watchfaces.title: Real Weather
watchfaces.author: Reno
watchfaces.description: Weather with personality — forecasts and conditions tuned for readability on color and B&W Pebbles alike.

watchfaces.title: Modern
watchfaces.author: Łukasz Zalewski
watchfaces.description: Minimal, high-contrast modern watchface that looks sharp on round and rectangular screens.

watchfaces.title: Weather Land
watchfaces.author: Reno
watchfaces.description: Playful weather landscape that changes with conditions — eye candy that stays legible in sunlight.

watchfaces.title: 91 Dub v4.0
watchfaces.author: orviwan
watchfaces.description: Bold typographic face with a music-forward layout. A style statement that still reads at arm’s length.

watchfaces.title: Mario Time Watchface
watchfaces.author: Alexey Cluster
watchfaces.description: Fan-favorite playful face — nostalgia bait done with love (not official Nintendo, obviously).

watchfaces.title: Studio Clock
watchfaces.author: Dale Perkel
watchfaces.description: Studio-grade analog clock aesthetics for dress-watch Pebble days.

watchfaces.title: Slides of Time
watchfaces.author: Morris
watchfaces.description: Smooth sliding time display — animation fans check battery impact, but the motion is chef’s kiss on e-paper.

watchfaces.title: Timely
watchfaces.author: Martin Norland (@cynorg)
watchfaces.description: Information-dense without clutter — calendar and time complications for people who live in their schedule.

watchfaces.title: DIN Time
watchfaces.author: Christian Liljeberg
watchfaces.description: Industrial DIN typography — crisp, European, unmistakable from across the room.

watchfaces.title: Futura Weather
watchfaces.author: Niknam Moslehi
watchfaces.description: Futura type plus weather data — design-nerd favorite that pairs style with shake-to-refresh forecasts.
